notes.notes:
New design and interface
New controller system with Joystick, Keyboard or Mouse
Device performance improved

This update put the focus on replayability, a score system has been introduced.

Find the right path to the exit while avoiding traps and guards is still the objective of each level but now if the player does it in the less possible steps he will increase its overall score.

So now, the steps number the player does is visible during the game phase and a results screen displays the current steps done at the end of the level and also the best score previously done on the same level, which is the smallest number of steps.
